description: Flow paths as Sankey. Pick dimension, filter exporter/protocol/port/CIDR. Top N (default 8) controls node count; Detail rows for the table below.

panels.description: Top N nodes per side; remainder rolled into Other. Use filters above to focus a slice of traffic.

targets.query:
WITH
    flows AS
    (
        SELECT
            if(etype = 2048,
               IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(sampler_address), 13, 4))),
               IPv6NumToString(sampler_address)) AS exporter,
            if(etype = 2048,
               IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))),
               IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) AS src_ip,
            if(etype = 2048,
               IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))),
               IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) AS dst_ip,
            ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), concat('proto-', toString(proto))) AS protocol,
            concat(
                ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), toString(proto)),
                '/',
                toString(dst_port)
            ) AS dst_service,
            bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate) AS traffic
        FROM $table
        WHERE $timeFilter
          AND ('$exporter' = 'All' OR if(etype = 2048,
               IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(sampler_address), 13, 4))),
               IPv6NumToString(sampler_address)) = '$exporter')
          AND ('$protocol' = 'All' OR ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), concat('proto-', toString(proto))) = '$protocol')
          AND ('$dst_port' = 'All' OR toString(dst_port) = '$dst_port')
          AND (
                '$src_net' = ''
             OR (
                    etype = 2048
                AND isIPAddressInRange(
                        IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))),
                        '$src_net'
                    )
                )
          )
          AND (
                '$dst_net' = ''
             OR (
                    etype = 2048
                AND isIPAddressInRange(
                        IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))),
                        '$dst_net'
                    )
                )
          )
    ),
    labeled AS
    (
        SELECT
            multiIf(
                '$dimension' = 'exp_dst', exporter,
                '$dimension' = 'src_port', src_ip,
                '$dimension' = 'proto_port', protocol,
                '$dimension' = 'exp_src', exporter,
                src_ip
            ) AS src_node,
            multiIf(
                '$dimension' = 'exp_dst', dst_ip,
                '$dimension' = 'src_port', dst_service,
                '$dimension' = 'proto_port', dst_service,
                '$dimension' = 'exp_src', src_ip,
                dst_ip
            ) AS dst_node,
            traffic
        FROM flows
    ),
    top_src AS
    (
        SELECT src_node
        FROM labeled
        GROUP BY src_node
        ORDER BY sum(traffic) DESC
        LIMIT toUInt64OrZero('$topn')
    ),
    top_dst AS
    (
        SELECT dst_node
        FROM labeled
        GROUP BY dst_node
        ORDER BY sum(traffic) DESC
        LIMIT toUInt64OrZero('$topn')
    )
SELECT
    if(src_node IN (SELECT src_node FROM top_src), src_node, 'Other') AS source,
    if(dst_node IN (SELECT dst_node FROM top_dst), dst_node, 'Other') AS destination,
    sum(traffic) AS traffic
FROM labeled
GROUP BY source, destination
HAVING traffic > 0
ORDER BY traffic DESC
LIMIT 300

targets.query:
SELECT
    if(etype = 2048,
       IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(sampler_address), 13, 4))),
       IPv6NumToString(sampler_address)) AS exporter,
    if(etype = 2048,
       IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))),
       IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) AS source,
    if(etype = 2048,
       IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))),
       IPv6NumToString(dst_addr)) AS destination,
    ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), toString(proto)) AS protocol,
    dst_port,
    sum(bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate)) AS traffic,
    count() AS flows
FROM $table
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND ('$exporter' = 'All' OR if(etype = 2048,
       IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(sampler_address), 13, 4))),
       IPv6NumToString(sampler_address)) = '$exporter')
  AND ('$protocol' = 'All' OR ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), concat('proto-', toString(proto))) = '$protocol')
  AND ('$dst_port' = 'All' OR toString(dst_port) = '$dst_port')
  AND (
        '$src_net' = ''
     OR (etype = 2048 AND isIPAddressInRange(
            IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '$src_net'))
  )
  AND (
        '$dst_net' = ''
     OR (etype = 2048 AND isIPAddressInRange(
            IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '$dst_net'))
  )
GROUP BY exporter, source, destination, protocol, dst_port
ORDER BY traffic DESC
LIMIT toUInt64OrZero('$detail_rows')
